Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 5

“The Blessed Lord said: Many births of mine have passed, and yours as well, Arjuna. I know them all, but you do not know them, scorcher of foes.”

The answer is not that Arjuna is wrong about birth but that he is wrong about counting. The difference between the two of them is memory, not nature — a strikingly level claim.
